name: True Focus
description: Sentence where one word at a time is in sharp focus while the others blur, with an animated frame (corner brackets, box, underline or highlight) that glides between words.
contents: Sentence split into words, each in its own span
Animated focus frame that moves and resizes to the active word
behavior: Auto-cycles through words on an interval of animationDuration plus pauseBetweenAnimations, sequentially or randomly
In manual mode the focus follows mouse hover over words
Unfocused words blur and can fade; the active word can scale up
Frame position is measured with ResizeObserver and follows layout changes
Easing is smooth cubic bezier or a springy overshoot
Reduced motion preference sets duration to 0 and disables spring
editableByProps: Frame style, color, glow, border width and corner size
Auto or hover-driven mode, sequential or random order
Timing, easing, blur, unfocused opacity and focus scale

needsCodeEdit.change: Change font size or weight of the words
needsCodeEdit.where: className on the word span inside words.map (text-[3rem] font-black)

needsCodeEdit.change: Change distance between frame and word

needsCodeEdit.where: gap-[1em] in the container div className

fixed: Word font size is hardcoded to 3rem, bold black weight
Words are laid out centered and wrapped in a flex row
Frame gap of 10px around the word is fixed
Text is not selectable and words show a pointer cursor
Needs at least 2 words for auto cycling
Unknown focusStyle values render corner brackets
Wide sentences wrap on small screens; frame follows via ResizeObserver

options.look: Four corner brackets around the active word
options.useWhen: Hero headline needing a camera viewfinder feel

options.look: Full rounded outline box around the active word
options.useWhen: Highlighting key terms in a feature statement with a clear border

options.look: Single bar sliding under the active word
options.useWhen: Minimal editorial tagline where a light accent is enough

options.look: Translucent filled marker behind the active word
options.useWhen: Playful about or CTA line that should look highlighted with a marker
